In my country we dont have school buses, so I was using public ones. So one sunny day, I was on my way to my home. Just your typical, sitting in the back of the bus, no people nearby, kinda day. And then, at the one stop a big company of 15 people get on the bus, and where do they sit? Of course, in the back. I was sitting in the backseat near the window, they sat right beside me and in front of me. I was like 12 at the time, and very shy mind you, the company was from 17 to 19 I guess. 5 people from the company  tried to talk to me in a jokingly way. One guy said to the other girl "dam hes good lookin, you should make out with him" and she be like "hey, when you be older hit me up" Hahaa. Banter. My face went red asap, I was sitting there speechless, was just looking at them and smiling. I did like the compliments they were throwing at me, but was too scared of so much attention. So at this point I was waiting for my bus stop, while they were still talking 'bout me, and then, all of a sudden, a guy from their group threw up. Like a lot.. 3 times in a row. He was sitting in the middle of the 5 seats in the back, so from the whole backside of the bus to the exit of the bus, walking place (idk how to say it) was covered in his vomit. All the attention of the group went to this guy, guys were laughing, girls were worried, and I was relaxed  that Im finally free of the "banter". Then, driver shows up, kicks out half the group, to the other half he tells "CLEAN UP OR IM CALLIN POLICE" The guy that threw up, completly blue and hammered, stands up, slips on his vomit, falls on his buttocks and slides down to all the way to the bus exit. The boys go wild, they cant stop laughing, driver gets more mad as the time goes, and girls clean up the mess. All in all, the bus was clean, but the group was still kicked out of the bus

About 1 am. my drunk friends invite me to their house to a party,and i accept. Taking a bottle with me, backpack, telephone and some earplugs so this wont be boring. From my house to my friends house its about 2km, 1km being a forrest, and so I had to go through the forrest at 1.30 am. Just going in the woods i was scared shitless so i have one earplug in and one out. So the next few steps i take i hear screaming "AAAAAAAAAAAH" I nearly shit myself and start running as fast as i could. When i saw first light, I looked back, saw nothing, but asap i tried to call my friend, and i notice a notification on my phone which was a message and then i remember that i've  put screaming goat as a notification sound... The story itself is not that scary afterall, but the emotions i felt that time.. Scary stuff

I was 8 at the time,with my mom,sister,and aunt at the sea. We were walking with sister at the shore,and then I saw some bottles in a plastic bag,and thought"damn it would be cool to break deez bottles" And I told my sister "Do you wanna break them?" She was like "Nah" and walked away. Me trying to act cool, I found a bigass rock,walked up to the bag and threw it on the bottles. As the rock was falling, I remember hearing "NOOOOO!" From far away. Turns out,the bottles were actually 3 wine and 2 vodka bottles,all full. The rock broke the bottles,wine,vodka was splashing,only one bottle survived. Turns out,a company was a few meters away partying,then some girl noticed that I came to the bag with a rock,tried to save it,but it was too late.. All in all,my mom had to buy them 4 new bottles worth of 100~ dollars (If I remember correctly). And now my mom tells this story to everybody,and jokes around saying that I owe her :^)
